claim: Adding workdays to Thursday 24 December 2026 skips the listed holidays as follows. One workday later is Monday 28 December, the Saturday holiday does not cost an extra day, and adding zero days returns the start date even when it is not a workday.
why: The README says a weekend holiday is observed on the following Monday and that Monday is skipped, but the code never does that. add_workdays steps one day at a time and counts only weekdays that are not listed, so the Saturday holiday is already skipped as a weekend. main.py prints 2026-12-28 for one workday and returns 2026-12-26 for zero days.

deciding.note: no extra day lost to the Saturday holiday
